population.provider: United Nations Department of Economic and Social Affairs, Population Division
population.locator: ISO3_code=FJI; Variant=Medium; Time=2020..2050; TPopulation1July; source values are thousands of people

food.provider: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
food.product: FAOSTAT Food Balance Sheets (2010-) and Supply Utilization Accounts (2010-)
food.locator: Area=Fiji; Years=2021..2023; resident Food/Food supply only; Tourist consumption excluded
food.method: Three-year arithmetic mean of resident kg/person/year. Exact SUA raw-item food quantities are divided by the matching FAOSTAT population where the aggregate FBS item is broader than the model crop.

crop_group_mapping.provider: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
crop_group_mapping.product: FAOSTAT Production: Crops and livestock products
crop_group_mapping.locator: Area=Fiji; Year=2020; Elements=Area harvested and Production
crop_group_mapping.method: The six CRPOTH items are the unique six-item subset that exactly reproduces the inherited 2020 OTH area (12,162 ha) and production (62,669.04 t).

trade.product: UN Comtrade annual HS trade data
trade.locator: period=2025; reporterCode=242 (Fiji); partnerCode=0 (World); flowCode=M or X; customsCode=C00; motCode=0; netWgt in kg
trade.limitation: UN Comtrade X is used as the physical-volume proxy because the Fiji annual release separates domestic exports and re-exports in value tables but does not publish the required detailed physical tonnes. For the selected Fiji-grown crop codes, re-export contamination is expected to be small but is not proven.

conversion_assumptions.milled_rice_basis: Fiji SUA Rice, 2021-2023: Rice, milled production divided by primary Rice processed is 0.68 in each year.
conversion_assumptions.husked_rice_basis: Transparent screening conversion for the negligible HS100620 flow; upgrade with a Fiji milling coefficient if this flow becomes material.
conversion_assumptions.raw_sugar_basis: Fiji SUA 2021-2023: raw centrifugal sugar production divided by sugar-cane processing is 0.14 in each year.
conversion_assumptions.coconut_products: HS080111, HS080112 and HS080119 net weights are added one-for-one because v2.8 adds no processed-coconut commodity. This is a disclosed no-new-commodity approximation.

CRPOTH_components: Edible roots and tubers with high starch or inulin content, n.e.c., fresh

model_policy.food_baseline: 2021-2023 average resident food use per person
model_policy.import_rule: 2025 import crop-equivalent volume multiplied by each year's population/2025 population is a minimum; additional high-cost imports remain open
model_policy.export_rule: 2025 export crop-equivalent volume multiplied by each year's population/2025 population is added to final demand
model_policy.import_variable_cost_role: screening penalty only; not a calibrated border price. Set above the maximum observed 2025 crop-balance marginal value in the unchanged v2.7 control (2.8529169 discounted, about 3.64 undiscounted) so domestic supply is preferred when feasible.
